test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 18 April 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Obscure
solution: The correct answer is '**Apparent**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate **antonym** of the given word '**Obscure**' is '**Apparent**'. • **Obscure**: not easy to see or understand. (जो आसानी से दिखाई न पड़े या समझ में न आए, धुँधला या दुर्बोध) • *Example: For some **obscure** reason, he decided to give up his well-paid job, to become a writer.* • **Apparent**: that seems to be real or true but may not be. (वास्‍तविक जैसा, आभासी) • *Example: It quickly became **apparent** to us that our teacher could not speak French.* **Correct Answer:__** *Apparent.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Blurred**: unable to see or be seen clearly. (स्पष्ट रूप से देखने या देखने में असमर्थ) • **Cloudy**: (used about the sky, etc.) full of clouds. [(आकाश) मेघाच्‍छन्‍न; बादलों से ढका] • **Veiled**: not expressed directly or clearly because you do not want your meaning to be obvious. (अप्रत्‍यक्ष या अस्‍पष्‍ट) 17c:T5ab, The correct answer is **'than any other channel'.**
